body.heading: Where in the world is Croatia?
paragraphs: Croatia is a country in Southern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Croatia is Zagreb.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Croatia is Croatian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Croatia is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Croatia?
paragraphs: Croatia covers about 57,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Bulgaria.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Dubrovnik's mighty walls circle a marble old town by the sparkling Adriatic — walk the full wall circuit, then ride the cable car up Mount Srđ.
At Plitvice, sixteen lakes tumble into each other through waterfalls, linked by wooden walkways — the water shifts from emerald to azure through the forest.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Croatia on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
